title: MASooda showcase: one campus afternoon, every feature
description: One 6-minute IITH afternoon at 38 °C with a 4 m/s westerly. 150 drones fly the campus corridors on 7 layers while the DTC and V2V layer agreement share the airspace and ADMM resolves conflicts. On top of that, in order: a non-cooperative intruder, two blood deliveries to the Hospital on the reserved emergency layer, GPS spoofing filtered by W-MSR and quarantined, operator console actions on a courier, a pop-up VIP restricted area, three battery/health faults handled by the BMS and DTC (pad arbitration, diversion, fleet grounding), a DTC link outage with a hold lost-link policy and a queued command, and a storm cell crossing the campus with a ground stop and a low-charge recall.
kpi_focus: BMS escalations, diversions, no energy depletion
